item.title: Ye Drops ‘Bully’ Deluxe Edition Featuring New Don Toliver Song, Shares Surreal ‘Kings’ Video
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: "What's trending on Billboard? We've got the latest update on Ye, formerly Kanye West. He's just dropped the deluxe edition of his album 'Bully', and it's packed with new content. Let's dive in."
[Upbeat background music starts playing]
Host: "The expanded version of 'Bully' features updated mixes of the original tracks, plus two brand new songs: 'OK' with Don Toliver and 'Mission Control'. And, to mark the occasion, Ye's unveiled a new music video for the album's opening track, 'Kings', directed by his wife Bianca Censori."
[Short audio clip from "Kings" music video]
Host: "The surreal video features Ye driving a convertible with a eclectic cast of passengers, before taking a dramatic turn. And, if you're excited about the new music, you won't have to wait long to see Ye live. He's got a string of shows lined up, including a July 4th performance at the Alamodome in San Antonio, and two dates in Chicago in September."
[Short audio clip from crowd cheering]
Host: "Ye's also performing in Tampa, Florida, on June 26 and 28, marking his first U.S. shows since April. And, if you're outside the States, don't worry – he's got international dates scheduled throughout the summer, including stops in Albania, Spain, and Portugal."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's the latest on Ye's 'Bully' deluxe edition. Make sure to check out the new music and catch him live if you can. We'll keep you updated on all the latest music news. Thanks for tuning in!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
